name: 1club-admin
description: Run your club's schedule, bookings, members, catalogue and website from your 1club account.

interface.longDescription: 1club Admin lets the owners and staff of sports clubs, gyms and studios that run on 1club manage their business from ChatGPT. Review the class schedule and rosters, find a member's bookings and remaining sessions, book courts and classes, record attendance, keep memberships and the product catalogue up to date, and edit your website as a draft you preview before publishing. Sign in with your 1club account and choose which business to connect; you decide which kinds of access to grant, and every action is limited to that business and to the access you granted.
defaultPrompt: Which classes are on this week, and how full are they?
Find Alex's upcoming bookings and sessions left on their membership.
Change the homepage headline and show me a preview.

positive.prompt: Which classes are on this week, and how full is each one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's class occurrences in the club's timezone with booked places against capacity, paging through results rather than stopping at the first page.

positive.prompt: Who is booked into the next Juniors - U16 class, and how many places are left?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the next upcoming Juniors - U16 occurrence, lists each booked attendee with their booking status, and reports the places left against its capacity.

positive.description: A member's bookings and remaining sessions
positive.prompt: Find Alex's upcoming bookings and how many sessions are left on their membership.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the member (asking which Alex if several match), then reports their upcoming bookings and the sessions remaining on each active membership.

positive.prompt: Schedule a 60 minute Junior Tennis class next Tuesday at 18:00 on Tennis Court 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the club, the Junior Tennis class type and Tennis Court 1, creates one 60 minute occurrence at 18:00 club time next Tuesday, and reports the class it created.

positive.description: Edit the website as a draft
positive.prompt: Change the homepage headline to 'Train with us' and show me a preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Edits the headline in the draft, returns the preview link, and does not publish the site because the user did not ask to.

negative.description: General coaching advice needs no club data, so ChatGPT answers it without calling 1club Admin.
negative.prompt: What's a good 20-minute warm-up for a junior tennis class?

negative.description: Booking a court as a player at another venue is not club administration, so 1club Admin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Find me a padel court I can book in Madrid this weekend.

negative.description: General tax advice needs no club data, so ChatGPT answers it without calling 1club Admin.
negative.prompt: How do I work out the VAT on a gym membership price in Spain?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is bought, sold or paid through ChatGPT. Staff can record a payment the club already collected elsewhere, or a refund of one, as a bookkeeping entry; no card is charged and no money moves.

publication.release_notes: First release: schedule, bookings, members, memberships, catalogue and website tools for 1club staff.
